Equating unusual duration with an invalid Dialed-In shot directly contradicts the product's Locked Master Specification §§16, 22–24.

[NIST Engineering Statistics Handbook, §1.3.5.17: Detection of Outliers](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/eda/section3/eda35h.htm) distinguishes **labeling** a suspicious point from **identifying** data error and deleting the point. It explains median/MAD modified Z scores, cites Iglewicz/Hoaglin's conventional **|modified Z| >3.5** *potential-outlier flag*, notes misleading conventional Z scores at small N and cautions about assumed distributions and masking. This is **general statistical methodology**, not an espresso-validated threshold.
